fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our expected fuel consumption in 2007, a hypothetical one dollar increase in the price of crude oil will increase our annual fuel expense by approximately $44 million (implies ~1,848 million projected gallons for 2007).

instrument_type_details.notes: At Dec 31, 2006: hedged approximately 30% of Q1 2007 and 10% of Q2 2007 projected fuel requirements using petroleum swap contracts (weighted average swap price $67.34/barrel) and heating oil zero-cost collar options (avg call $1.90/gallon, avg put $1.77/gallon). Fair value obligation $18 million (liability). Fuel hedges had negative impact of $40 million to fuel expense in 2006.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (millions) 1,471 [2006] 1,376 [2005] 1,333 [2004] (Item 6 selected operating data; Continental Airlines standalone)
